label: Order
caption: JOSE DURAN, INDIVIDUALLY AND AS REPRESENTATIVE OF A CLASS OF JUDGMENT CREDITORS OF THE ESTATE OF FERDINAND E. MARCOS V. UNITED STATES, ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit, case Nos. 24-185 and 25-186, is hereby recalled and stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, November 12, 2025, by 4 p.m. (EST).
